headline: Madison Dearborn Partners to Acquire Peli BioThermal
summary: Madison Dearborn Partners has agreed to acquire Peli BioThermal from Pelican Products and Platinum Equity. The deal provides strategic capital to accelerate the healthcare supply chain provider's global growth.
why: Peli BioThermal is a significant provider of cold chain solutions for the pharmaceutical industry, a sector that has seen increased M&A activity due to complex logistics requirements.
